scope: Two Linux agents on single-NIC QEMU controllers, AWS Windows 2022/2025 replacement workers; graceful agent withdrawal and generated-addon migration

coverage.scope: Targeted Go unit suite only; not project-wide coverage or native runtime coverage

limitations: Agent withdrawal used Deployment scale-to-zero, allowing graceful termination; no power loss, partition, or abrupt-process failure proof.
The generated DaemonSet was validated on an existing site; the new fresh-site lab flag has unit coverage but has not yet completed a fresh VM bringup.
Dry-run Machine updates exercise admission, not new EC2 provisioning or CAPI deletion with this addon.
No independence assumption for HTTP keepalive connections or request samples.
The original immediate baseline also passed; no quantified reduction in intermittent admission failure rate.
Old aws-win2025 exec failure from the preceding observation remains unresolved; replacement-node success is not all-node exec proof.
All-default-route-agent loss can fall back to unsuitable Windows agents.
Windows fragmentation and GPU startup reliability remain release blockers.
